name: Community Library
description: Track the things a community shares — books, tools, gear — and who has them checked out. Editors add items, check them out to someone on a members list (or anyone by name) for a set time, check them in and flag problems; overdue items show themselves. The owner sets the item types, loan lengths and whether only they may edit. Members see who has what; anyone else sees only what is in and what is out. Items are the space's library_assets table; borrowers come from the members list an editor picks for each copy of the frame (members.table.jsonl, or one such as club.members.table.jsonl), the roster Member Manager keeps.
